Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，English explanation: “古代” is already a time expression, so adding “的时候” is redundant.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 当上医：当上医生，English explanation: “医” is not normally used alone as the noun for this occupation; “医生” is the standard noun.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个很漂亮的植物：一株很漂亮的植物，English explanation: “株” is the matching measure word for an individual plant; “个” is too generic here.
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药：他有一个问题，不知道什么东西能做药，English explanation: use zero form for the same subject when it re-occurs within the same sentence and no other character competes as the referent.
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 找到有植物的地方：找到了有植物的地方，English explanation: use 了 after the resultative verb phrase to mark the completed action of finding the place.
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 他看到一个很漂亮的植物：他看到了一个很漂亮的植物，English explanation: use 了 after the resultative complement 到 to mark this completed event in the narrative.

items.reason: “古代的时候” redundantly combines two time expressions, and “在古代” is correct.
“医” alone is not the appropriate occupation noun here; “医生” is correct.
“个” is less specific than “株” but is acceptable with “植物,” so this is not an error.
The repeated subject “他” is unnecessary when the same referent continues within the sentence.
Finding the place is a completed narrative event, so “找到了” correctly marks completion.
Seeing the plant is the completed final event in the action sequence, so “看到了” is appropriate.
